openings.claim: Build a digest-linked boundary map against expected manifest order, retaining missing links and timestamp conflicts. Report the earliest supported mismatch with unresolved preceding boundaries explicitly exposed.
openings.delta: Moves from isolated artifact comparison to bounded localization; recorded equality does not exclude hidden earlier divergence and reconvergence.
openings.prediction: The inverted export timestamp will trigger an ordering caveat rather than automatically move the divergence before parse. Missing transform digests will prevent unsupported transform-stage certainty.
openings.probe: For each pair, record boundary agreements, mismatches and gaps using supplied identifiers. Count every manual inspection, stop at twelve, freeze claims, then compare supported locations and unresolved intervals with the sealed answers.
assumptions: Compared digests denote compatible artifact boundaries according to the supplied dictionary.
Manifest order describes expected workflow order, not proof of actual execution chronology.

openings.claim: Can choosing the next supplied record by its ability to narrow the earliest unresolved interval maintain useful localization under the inspection cap and record removal?
openings.delta: Turns the evidence ledger into a budgeted inspection policy with an explicit stopping rule and resource-feasible next check.
openings.prediction: Removing transform evidence will preserve a previously justified location only if remaining records support it; otherwise uncertainty expands. The policy may reduce inspections, but that advantage is unestablished.
openings.probe: Compare stage-order and interval-directed inspection on the disjoint three-pair subsets. Freeze outputs after the specified removals; open answer sheets afterward. Compare correctness, interval width and inspection counts within twenty minutes; subset differences limit efficacy claims.
assumptions: An uninspected supplied record can sometimes resolve a boundary; missing records cannot be recovered with these resources.

assessment: Beneficiaries need correct early localization, honest uncertainty and an actionable next check. Central predictions concern unsupported certainty under timestamp conflict and evidence loss. Blank warnings cannot establish absence of trouble. These are synthetic workflow proposals, not measured effects; summary-level observations supply no record identifiers for definite run-level stage claims.
